Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding points of diversion under a water right.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to changes in the point of diversion under a waterright; and amending RCW 90.03.397.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 90.03.397 and 1999 c 232 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thissection unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (a) "Mainstem of the Columbia and Snake rivers" means the mainstemof the Columbia and Snake rivers from the Bonneville dam to the upperlimits of the pool behind the Chief Joseph dam on the Columbia river,from the confluence of the Snake river and the Columbia river to theupper limits of the pool behind the Ice Harbor dam. (b) "Pool" means any surface water reservoir where water iscollected and stored for subsequent beneficial use. (2) The department may approve a change of the point of diversionprescribed in a permit or certificate to appropriate water for abeneficial use to a point of diversion that is located downstream, orin the same pool of the mainstem of the Columbia and Snake rivers, andis an ((existing)) approved intake structure ((with capacity to p. 1 SHB 1453transport the additional diversion,)) if the ownership, purpose of use,season of use, and place of use of the permit remain the same. Therequirement in RCW 90.03.395 that a change in point of diversion of awater right permit must provide environmental benefits does not applyfor a change of point of diversion that is located in the same pool ofthe mainstem of the Columbia and Snake rivers. (3) This section may not be construed as limiting in any mannerwhatsoever other authorities of the department under RCW 90.03.380 orother changes that may be approved under RCW 90.03.380 underauthorities existing before July 25, 1999.
